qualificationBasis: A market is published only when at least 2 distinct holders on the same outcome each have a complete last-30-days record, at least 10 closed markets, and a 90%+ profitable-close rate. Only qualifying traders are counted.

scanDiagnostics.note: All available Data API v2 cursor pages of open positions are scanned per discovered wallet; walletsWithMorePositions flags cursor pagination that could not be exhausted. Closed-position profitability records are separately scanned over the full requested 7/30-day window.

candidatePoolBasis: All unique wallets exposed by available public Data API v2 leaderboard cursors across overall, sports, politics, crypto, esports, culture, mentions, weather, economics, tech, and finance categories and DAY/WEEK/MONTH/ALL periods, sorted by PnL and volume. The public API does not expose a literal all-wallet directory, so this is the broadest discoverable leaderboard pool rather than a guaranteed census. Every available open-position page is scanned; final consensus includes only same-outcome groups with at least 2 independently qualified traders.
recordBasis: Only active markets with at least 2 distinct same-outcome traders who each pass the complete last-30-days 90%+ profitable-close rate and 10+ closed-market requirements are published. Markets with qualifying consensus on both opposing outcomes are excluded.
